title: Smoky Fish Fry
description: A traditional British-style fish fry with a smoky twist, perfect for a quick and delicious meal.

ingredients.name: Salt
ingredients.notes: Use sea salt for the best flavor

instructions: 1. Heat the oil in a deep frying pan or a deep fryer to 350°F (175°C).
2. In a bowl, mix together the fry batter mix, smoked paprika, salt, and black pepper.
3. Dip each cod fillet into the batter mix, making sure it's fully coated.
4. Carefully place the battered cod fillets into the hot oil.
5. Fry the cod for 3-4 minutes on each side, or until golden brown and cooked through.
6. Remove the cod from the oil with a slotted spoon and place on a paper towel-lined plate to drain excess oil.
7. Serve the smoky fish fry hot with lemon wedges on the side.
